bundle.shortDescription: Papercusp GUI — nightly channel (installs alongside the stable app)
bundle.longDescription: The nightly build of the Papercusp GUI, cut daily from main. It is a SEPARATE application: its own bundle id, its own name, and its own data home (~/.papercusp-nightly), so it never reads or writes the state of the Papercusp you use for real work. Install it beside the stable app, not instead of it.
